component.name: LogicForge
component.summary: Design and simulate digital logic circuits

description.p: LogicForge is a digital logic simulator for learning, teaching and experimenting with hardware. Circuits are drawn in an interactive editor and simulated with four-state signals — 0, 1, X (unknown) and Z (not driven) — so tri-state buses and driver conflicts behave the way they do in real hardware.

ul.li: Gates, latches, flip-flops, registers, counters, multiplexers, adders, an ALU, RAM and ROM
Reusable subcircuits that can be opened and edited in context
Real 7400-series chips placed and wired as physical DIP packages
A logic analyzer with edge and value triggers
The programmable LF-8 educational computer with an assembler, interrupts and memory-mapped I/O
A Study window to step through a running circuit, including breakpoints on the LF-8

description.p: Projects are stored as versioned, human-readable JSON files. LogicForge works entirely offline and collects no data.
